title: J! Quickcap: 11/26/2025
text:
Our mid-week challengers…
–Shannon Mastick, a patent attorney from Granger, IN
–Krish Patel, an undergraduate student from Plano, TX
…will try and make the twelfth game the last for Continuing Superchamp Harrison Whitaker (11-day: $309K)
Correct/Incorrect: 49/9
Rebounds/Rebound Attempts: 2/2 (1/1 each for Harrison & Shannon)
Unplayed Clues ($ left on the board): 0 ($0)
Coryat Score: $33,200 (+$7,800 vs. yesterday)
Lach Trash: $10,800 from 10 triple stumpers (-$6K and -4 triple stumpers vs. yesterday)
Coryat lost to incorrect responses (less double-correct responses): $10K (-$1,800 vs. yesterday)
Daily Double Correct Answers: 2
PRE-FJ! SCORES
Harrison: $17,200 (LOCK…I think you know where this is headed, folks) | Krish: $5,600 | Shannon: $5,400 (Combined: another low $28,200)
CORYAT SCORE
Harrison: $22,200
Final Jeopardy! Category: Famous Declarations
Final Jeopardy! Correct Answers: 1
RETURNING BACK WHERE SHE STARTED: Shannon (she “got out” alright…to bankruptcy)
Winner again (this time with the only right answer): Harrison ($21K)–now he can say “I shall return with a 12-day total of $330K!”
The next to beam up to the Trebek stage and try and make 13 an unlucky number for Harrison: Paul Wenzel from Lancaster, PA and Nicole Haase from Milwaukee, WI.
Bobby’s Rating: 7 (C-)
Ismael’s Rating: 6 (D+)
Jerry’s Rating: 5 (D)
Statistical Winning Show, and a possible Turkey Day away from a Winning Week at the Trebek Stage.
On to 25WOF!
